cases.question: I need an MIT starting point for a small Python in-memory mutable mapping cache. Bound it by item count, evict the least recently used key, promote successful reads and replacements, and leave recency unchanged for membership checks. It will run in one thread. After inspecting the source, propose a standalone standard-library-only adaptation exposing LRUCache(maxsize), maxsize and currsize properties, normal mapping operations, clear(), and popitem() that removes the least recently used entry. Accept only nonnegative integer capacities, reject booleans or other types with ValueError, and reject insertion at zero capacity with ValueError. I do not need time expiry, decorators, custom value sizing or persistence.
reviewRequirements: LRUCache reads and writes touch order, membership does not
